data.body:
**[P1] Do not invoke customer transforms while holding the per-invocation lock**

`_emit()` is called inside this `RLock` and executes configured input/output transforms and operation-result overrides. These callbacks are shared customer code and can re-enter another live plugin instance; if two overlapping invocations re-enter each other, each thread waits on the other's lock and both invocations hang. `_hook_frame` only defers drains and record releases, so it does not prevent this direct inversion. Snapshot and increment the revision under `_lock`, release it while building the record, then reacquire it to revalidate and schedule atomically. Add a barrier-based two-invocation re-entry test.
